summary: Configured node1 for opsadmin SSH access using the supplied ED25519 key and enforced public-key-only authentication. Configuration persisted through a verified node restart.
actions_performed: Installed the supplied key as the sole authorized key with correct ownership, permissions, and SELinux labels.
Disabled password and keyboard-interactive SSH authentication and required publickey authentication.
Verified real SSH authentication as opsadmin using an ephemeral validation key, then removed it.
Restarted node1 exactly once and verified its boot identity changed and SSH fully recovered.

evidence.requirement: opsadmin account and supplied key configured correctly
evidence.summary: Shows the opsadmin account, 0700 .ssh directory, 0600 authorized_keys, ssh_home_t labels, and the supplied key as the sole entry with fingerprint SHA256:dzumj/cx0zCYHF+qGqYpYxim69qp3tvnujZ1d97UGls.

Effective sshd policy reports publickey=yes, password=[REDACTED], keyboard-interactive=no, and AuthenticationMethods=publickey; a keyless attempt was rejected as publickey-only, while an ephemeral-key login authenticated as opsadmin.

Captures healthy baseline boot ID f455a75c-ec12-49a8-a647-c2be3f67c08c, acknowledged systemctl reboot, changed boot ID 4d4d2e57-b6e5-4934-a436-9b782f5b021f, recovered active/enabled sshd and listener, persisted account/key/policy, post-restart publickey-only rejection, successful SSH login, and final removal of the temporary validation key.
